scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.base.1
Scavenger's Notes: The tin roof still drips. The pile to the north steams - today's fresh dump.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.base.2
Scavenger's Notes: Only half the junkyard lights are on. The other half belongs to the rats.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.base.3
Scavenger's Notes: Wind pours down the vent shaft, smelling of rust and wet cardboard.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.base.4
Scavenger's Notes: The incinerator is still warm. You roll up your sleeves and borrow its light.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.base.5
Scavenger's Notes: The watch robot is gone. Probably charging again.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.base.6
Scavenger's Notes: You cinch the bag shut and flex your fingers.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.new_trash.1
Scavenger's Notes: The fresh trash smells sharper: motor oil, disinfectant, burnt plastic.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.new_trash.2
Scavenger's Notes: Nobody has picked through this pile yet. Not tonight, anyway.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.george.1
Scavenger's Notes: Georgio's people have been told. No one will chase you off tonight.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.george.2
Scavenger's Notes: A lamp is still burning in the corner of the shed. You know who left it.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.careful.1
Scavenger's Notes: You check the ground first, then crouch.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.osteo.1
Scavenger's Notes: Your knee pops. You shift your weight and lower yourself slowly.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.hazard.1
Scavenger's Notes: A faint clink of broken glass, like a fingernail tapping a cup.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.hazard.2
Scavenger's Notes: Something sour seeps up from below. It stings your nose.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.hazard.3
Scavenger's Notes: The bag shifts. Could be a rat. Could be something else.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.hazard.4
Scavenger's Notes: A jagged metal edge catches the light.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.rare.1
Scavenger's Notes: A faint smell of ozone. Something electrical?

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.rare.2
Scavenger's Notes: One bag is heavier than it should be.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.rare.3
Scavenger's Notes: Clean machine oil. Machine parts?

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.empty.1
Scavenger's Notes: Only soaked paper in that patch.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.empty.2
Scavenger's Notes: Empty. Even the rats have moved on.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.empty.3
Scavenger's Notes: The bag is flat. A puddle underneath.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.item.1
Scavenger's Notes: Something hard under your fingers. Small.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.item.2
Scavenger's Notes: Feels like cloth wrapped around something.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.item.3
Scavenger's Notes: The clink of metal. Light.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.quiet.1
Scavenger's Notes: Nothing. Just your own breathing.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.quiet.2
Scavenger's Notes: Too quiet.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.initial
Scavenger's Notes: Where do you start?

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.common.1
Scavenger's Notes: Your hand closes on {0}. You wipe off the dust - still usable.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.common.2
Scavenger's Notes: You pull {0} out from under a cardboard box.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.common.3
Scavenger's Notes: You find {0}, wedged against the drain grate.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.common.4
Scavenger's Notes: {0}. You weigh it in one hand. Solid.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.rare.1
Scavenger's Notes: Something's buried underneath: {0}. Your hands shake as you lift it out.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.rare.2
Scavenger's Notes: This doesn't belong here: {0}. You pocket it fast.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.rare.3
Scavenger's Notes: {0}. Too clean for this place.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.extra.backpack.1
Scavenger's Notes: There's another bag behind the first. You pull the zipper open.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.extra.backpack.2
Scavenger's Notes: A backpack strap is tangled in the rebar. You work it loose.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.extra.cassette.1
Scavenger's Notes: A cassette. The label is waterlogged.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.extra.cassette.2
Scavenger's Notes: The shell is cracked, tape still spooled inside.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.extra.more
Scavenger's Notes: A few smaller things too. You stuff them into your bag.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.empty.1
Scavenger's Notes: Nothing. You toss the bag back.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.empty.2
Scavenger's Notes: You dig to the bottom. Only foul water.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.empty.3
Scavenger's Notes: Your fingers reach the bottom. Empty.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.hazard_passed
Scavenger's Notes: You get past the hazard, but this square is empty.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.minor.1
Scavenger's Notes: A cold sting at your fingertip, then pain. Blood wells up.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.minor.2
Scavenger's Notes: A rusty nail opens a gash. Not deep, but it needs wrapping.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.minor.3
Scavenger's Notes: Broken glass bites into your palm. You swear and pull back.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.major.1
Scavenger's Notes: A sheet of metal pins your arm. You pull free to a sound you shouldn't hear.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.major.2
Scavenger's Notes: The ground gives way. You drop into waist-high scrap. Your left leg won't hold you.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.luck.1
Scavenger's Notes: Your hand slips. The glass grazes your knuckles.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.luck.2
Scavenger's Notes: Something moves overhead. You pull your hand back in time.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.luck.3
Scavenger's Notes: That was close. You stare at the cut for two seconds.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.immunity.1
Scavenger's Notes: That one didn't touch you. You still have some margin.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.immunity.2
Scavenger's Notes: Luck was on your side. Not necessarily next time.

Scavenger's Notes: Reach

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.action.listen

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.action.withdraw
Scavenger's Notes: Call it a night

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.status.low_battery
Scavenger's Notes: The flashlight dims.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.status.last_attempt
Scavenger's Notes: One search left.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.status.no_attempts
Scavenger's Notes: You're out of strength.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.status.wounded_stop
Scavenger's Notes: The wound throbs. You can't search anymore tonight.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.status.wounded_pause
Scavenger's Notes: The wound throbs. Bandage it and you can keep going.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.status.resume
Scavenger's Notes: Bandaged. You can keep going.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.end.withdraw.1
Scavenger's Notes: You straighten up and cinch the bag. That's enough for tonight.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.end.withdraw.2
Scavenger's Notes: Something collapses in the distance. You decide not to push your luck.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.end.withdraw.3
Scavenger's Notes: Leave the rest for tomorrow. You turn and walk out.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.end.injured.1
Scavenger's Notes: You haul yourself up on the steel rack. Blood drips onto the waste paper.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.end.injured.2
Scavenger's Notes: The walk back takes longer than the walk here.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.end.done.1
Scavenger's Notes: You straighten up and dust off your hands.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.end.done.2
Scavenger's Notes: The wind outside the shed hasn't let up.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.end.summary.1
Scavenger's Notes: Tonight's haul: {0}.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.end.summary.2
Scavenger's Notes: {0}. Enough for a few days' rent - or not.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.end.summary.3
Scavenger's Notes: You lay out tonight's haul: {0}.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.end.summary.empty
Scavenger's Notes: You come back with nothing tonight.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.note.metal.1
Scavenger's Notes: Metal. The edges are worn smooth with age.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.note.metal.2
Scavenger's Notes: Heavy, cold, and it rings when you tap it.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.note.fabric.1
Scavenger's Notes: The cloth is thick with dust. One shake and you're coughing.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.note.fabric.2
Scavenger's Notes: The stitching is tight. Not cheap work.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.note.tech.1
Scavenger's Notes: The casing is scored with pry marks. Nothing rattles inside.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.note.tech.2
Scavenger's Notes: The connector is an old standard. You'll need an adapter.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.note.chem.1
Scavenger's Notes: A ring of white crystals around the cap. Don't smell it.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.note.chem.2
Scavenger's Notes: The label is torn. Only half a warning left.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.note.med.1
Scavenger's Notes: The packaging is still sealed. Lucky.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.note.med.2
Scavenger's Notes: Good until next year. Assuming anyone will take it.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.note.weapon.1
Scavenger's Notes: The edge is chipped. Still plenty sharp enough to hurt someone.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.note.weapon.2
Scavenger's Notes: Gun oil still hangs in the air. Someone cleaned it recently.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.note.food.1
Scavenger's Notes: Smells all right. You still don't dare taste it.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.note.food.2
Scavenger's Notes: The package is swollen. Throw it out.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.note.odd.1
Scavenger's Notes: No idea what it does. Keep it for now.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.note.odd.2
Scavenger's Notes: A serial number is stamped on it. No way to trace it.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.tool.flashlight.1
Scavenger's Notes: The flashlight hangs at your hip. You click it on - the beam is full of dust.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.tool.metal_scanner.1
Scavenger's Notes: The scanner is warm in your pocket. It might still beep a few times tonight.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.tool.crowbar.1
Scavenger's Notes: The crowbar rides across your back. Every step knocks steel against your hip.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.tool.magnifier.1
Scavenger's Notes: The magnifier sits in your chest pocket. There's an old scratch across the lens.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.tool.welder.1
Scavenger's Notes: The cutting torch hangs at your waist, dragging your belt down.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.tool.wire_cutter.1
Scavenger's Notes: The rubber grips of the wire cutters are slick with sweat.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.intro.tool.screwdriver.1
Scavenger's Notes: The screwdriver is in your pocket, its handle wrapped in tape.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.sealed.1
Scavenger's Notes: A sealed plastic crate nearby, bound with two straps.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.sealed.2
Scavenger's Notes: The lid is screwed shut. You won't get in without tools.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.machine.1
Scavenger's Notes: A dead machine. The casing is intact - something's still inside.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.machine.2
Scavenger's Notes: The indicator light on the case is still on. Red.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.pry.1
Scavenger's Notes: The lid comes off. The inside is packed with desiccant paper.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.pry.2
Scavenger's Notes: The metal curls back. You tear the whole crate open.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.inspect.safe.1
Scavenger's Notes: Just a flattened cardboard box. Don't waste your strength.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.inspect.hazard.1
Scavenger's Notes: Something glints under the lens. A broken edge - don't reach in.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.inspect.rare.1
Scavenger's Notes: Copper glints under the lens. A circuit board.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.dismantle.welder
Scavenger's Notes: The cutter hums once. You carve {0} out of the machine casing.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.dismantle.wire_cutter
Scavenger's Notes: The cutters bite into the harness and pull it free: {0}.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.dismantle.screwdriver
Scavenger's Notes: The screwdriver turns the last screw and frees {0}.

Scavenger's Notes: No crowbar. The crate won't open.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.status.no_magnifier
Scavenger's Notes: No magnifier. You can't make it out.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.inspect.sealed.1
Scavenger's Notes: Seals under the lens. You can't see inside.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.status.scan_double
Scavenger's Notes: The scanner beeps again.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.status.inspect_used
Scavenger's Notes: You put the magnifier away. That was your one look tonight.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.extra.1
Scavenger's Notes: That patch is heavier than it looks. Might be more than one thing.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.clue.extra.2
Scavenger's Notes: Two different corners poke out of the bag.

Scavenger's Notes: Two layers of shadow under the lens. More than one.

scavarcade.ui.title: scavarcade.result.inspect.machine.1
